text: For a stone at (7,7), radius one gives a 3 × 3 square with eight empty candidates; radius two gives a 5 × 5 square with 24. With the single stone at (0,0), the radius-two square is clipped to a 3 × 3 corner and yields eight candidates. Multiple stones may nominate the same cell, but seen prevents duplicates. If a radius produces no raw candidates on a nonfull board, the documented selection code falls back to legal moves, avoiding an occupied placeholder. An empty player and a full board return no candidates [10].
